_comment: Net deposits = base + the sum of every ledger entry. Plaid shows Vanguard transactions only from Aug 2026 onward, so 'base' is the fixed total deposited through 'base_through' (per Vanguard statements) and never changes. Every deposit or withdrawal after that is added to the ledger automatically by fetch.js, keyed by Plaid's transaction id; Vanguard's internal VMFXX settlement-fund sweeps are recognised and excluded. You should not need to edit this file.
